title: Quarter-end finance & legal scramble
content:
Quick brain dump — march quarter wrap up. messy, forgive me.

TOP PRIORITIES (this week)
- final pass on vendor invoices: Acme Cloud (INV-5589) + BulkTrans shipping (INV-8472). check PO match, tax codes. flag anything > $5k to Priya.
- contract redlines for Analytics Labs renewal (term + data residency). legal wants: fresher data deletion clause, stronger audit window. deadline: Wed EOD (2026-03-11).
- renewal reminder queue: 3 customers auto-renewing Apr 1 — need manual check for rate adjustments.

TODO (ordered by urgency)
1) Acme Cloud invoice: discrepancy in line 3 (network egress listed twice). Action: email ap@acme + attach screenshot. target: 2026-03-10.
2) BulkTrans: missing PO number. call ops (Marcus) to confirm shipment batch id. target: 2026-03-11.
3) Analytics Labs contract: incorporate SSO clause + KMS key rotation schedule. ping legal (Priya) for redline template. target: 2026-03-11.
4) Renewal checklist for customers A/B/C: run usage delta report (billing team) and propose tier change if delta > 25%. create short memo for AMs. target: 2026-03-12.
5) Reconcile credit memos from Feb: check statement for vendor X. target: 2026-03-13.

NOTES / SCRATCHES
- If we push Analytics Labs renew to quarterly billing, need finance sign-off — risk: cashflow hit.
- Data deletion language — propose: "customer-initiated deletion within 30 days, verified by export log". legal might want 90 days.
- Who owns contract storage? We put signed copy in Box + link into Salesforce opp. Add checklist step: upload signed PDF to "Contracts/Signed/2026Q1" (manual for now).

CALLS / SLACKS TO SEND
- @Priya — quick sync 30m to go through redline priorities (tomorrow morning).
- Marcus — confirm BulkTrans shipment details; pinged on slack, no reply yet.
- Billing ops channel: request usage delta run for three renewals (tag @billing-ops).

RISK / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Are any invoices subject to withholding tax? Noted on Acme invoice but unclear. Need tax team input (cc: tax@redwood).
- Is Analytics Labs requesting exceptions to our standard security addendum? They mentioned FedRAMP-ish language — escalate if yes.

QUICK LOG (for audit)
- 2026-03-09 09:24 — found duplicate network line on ACME INV-5589. saved screenshot acme-dup-0326.png
- 2026-03-09 11:02 — slack: messaged Marcus re: BulkTrans.
- 2026-03-10 08:15 — drafted redline for Analytics Labs (see attached draft in Confluence).

STUBS / TEXT SNIPPETS (for emails)
- To vendor re: duplicate charge: "Hi — we're reconciling INV-5589 and noticed network egress listed twice on lines 3/4. Can you confirm which is correct and resend updated invoice?"
- To AM re: renewal: "Heads up — usage increased 38% QoQ; recommend moving customer to Pro tier on next renewal. See attached usage extract."

FILES / WHERE I STORED STUFF
- Screenshots: /home/zoe/tmp/acme-dup-0326.png (will upload to Confluence after confirmation)
- Draft redline: https://confluence.company/fin/analytics-labs-redline-draft (work in progress)

MISC NOTES / REMINDERS
- Remember to update the Renewal Tracker spreadsheet before EOD Friday.
- Ask legal for clause library link (I keep typing the same clause from memory — stop that).

END-OF-DAY CHECK (2026-03-12)
- Completed: Acme e-mail sent, redline draft uploaded.
- Pending: BulkTrans PO number, billing usage report.

Random TODO later: set up small template for "invoice quick triage" that I can reuse (checkboxes: PO match, tax, duplicates, credits). save as doc: invoice-triage-template.

Unresolved thoughts: maybe build a tiny Google Sheet that tracks vendors with >$10k monthly spend + contact. would save a lot.

----
Personal note to self: breathe. this is quarter-end; prioritize removables and escalate blockers early.
